note: Every page a product manager's service proposal covers: about two pages per viewpoint (an overview page, then a deep-dive page), each a distinct decision-relevant view, in 11 numbered chapters plus the summary and an appendix. pdm-deck.py builds every page in this order; a page the spec leaves without content is still built, marked 未検討, with its questions, the stages that fill it and the intended shape, so a missing consideration is visible. blocks is the recommended set of blocks for the page, shape says the intended picture in words, questions are the three a decision-maker would ask of it.
